title: Alamar Tsakanin Duwatsu
intro: A ƙasar da aka sassaka tsaunuka a gidaje, wani manzo ya zo da wata alama ta mu'ujiza daga Allah. Mutane sun nemi hujja, kuma suka sami wata halitta daga dutse mai ƙarfi. Amma girman kansu ya sa suka ƙi gargaɗin, yana rufe makomarsu.
clues: An aiko ni zuwa ga mutanen da ke zaune a gidajen da aka sassaka daga duwatsu.
Sun ƙalubalance ni da in kawo wata alama, don haka na samar da raƙumi daga dutse.
Na umarce su da su bar raƙumi ya sha ruwa ba tare da wata illa ba.
Sun yi rashin biyayya suka kuma yanke rakumin, suna ƙin gargaɗina.
Na sanar da cewa hukuncin zai zo bayan kwana uku.
Da safe, wata babbar fashewa ta lalata su, amma ni da mabiyana muka tsira.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Buƙatar teburi daga sama ta yaɗu
Bukatar sanda don ta zama maciji

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An lalata shi da wata babbar fashewa
outcome.answer: An lalata shi da wata babbar fashewa

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
